content:
**Dromedary** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

Drinking satisfies more thirst.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | All drinks quench thirst by an additional 100%. | 0009D1FD | 
| ★ | 1 | All drinks quench thirst by an additional 50%. | 0003D966 | 

Before Update 60, the perk had 3 ranks that increased thirst satisfaction by 25%/50%/75%.

Slow Metabolizer - similar perk for hunger

The dromedary (*Camelus dromedarius*), also known as the Arabian camel, is a species of camel that has one hump.
